explanation: Job 2 received complete demand/provenance fields in its input, but its observed output did not preserve the stipulated demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields in the selected coverage/priorities records. Because the downstream job input already contained the full records, the visible evidence localizes the fault to job_2, but no function name is supplied.
cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require: "Select all qualifying or fallback demand records and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight."
Job 2 input needs include full records, e.g. n06-r01 has demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5.
Observed Job 2 coverage records contain only capability_id, coverage, need, and record_id; they omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
Observed Job 2 priorities records contain capability_id, coverage, need, priority_rank, record_id, unsupported, and upstream_rank; they omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
